sample_unit: patients (manually annotated cases in the 2022-2023 test set)
unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning an LLM on manually annotated pathology reports to extract structured biomarker testing data
Temporal validation of the trained model on a later patient cohort (2022-2023) with manual annotation of a random sample

screen.reason: The study develops and validates an LLM-based information extraction tool on retrospective Dutch pathology reports for cancer registry/epidemiology purposes, evaluating extraction performance without testing organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
